sources.name: John Ellis
sources.quote: That game was everything I’ve been working for—every pitch, every inning. It’s not just about shutting them out; it’s about setting the tone for what’s next. We’re here to win, and that performance was a statement. The A’s are locked in, and I’m ready to keep pushing.

sources.name: Eric Taveras
sources.quote: Man, what John did out there... that was next level. When your ace goes out and dominates like that in a playoff game, it changes everything. Now we've got momentum, and the whole team's feeding off that energy. You could feel it in the dugout - like, if he's bringing that kind of fire, how can the rest of us not step up?

sources.name: Rick Walker
sources.quote: I heard about John Ellis' shutout on the radio this morning—what a performance! It’s got me thinking the A’s might just have the pitching depth to make a serious playoff run this year.

sources.name: Rafael Pilgrim
sources.quote: I heard about John Ellis' shutout—nine innings, no runs. It’s got people here in Fruitvale buzzing, thinking the A’s might just have the pitching depth to go deep in the playoffs.
